description: Append-only audit log for docs/PROVIDER_SCORECARD.md — every quarterly audit adds one entry.

history.changes: Patch audit: introduced machine-readable provider YAML layer (docs/scorecard/providers/) + generator + CI validator. Two cells moved when the generator recomputed scores from the rubric — both were hand-scoring errors in the v2.0.0 audit caught by the deterministic recomputation.

Monday.com.reason: D1 was hand-scored 3 but sub-criteria yield 4 of 5 met (task_crud ✓, container_crud ✓, native_subtasks ✓, no_ops_gap ✓; core_fields_80pct ✗). Rubric recomputation corrects to 4.

MS Planner.reason: D4 was hand-scored band 4 using a per-tenant estimate, but rubric §5 mandates the programmatic-integration path's documented ceiling (130k req/10s per-app) = 780k ops/min = band 5.
